scope_review: Learner drives or prepares an ordinary passenger car; other vehicle classes only appear as traffic participants.
learning_objective: Pluie sur une route ordinaire limitée à 90
novelty_review: Rain reduction on an ordinary undivided 90 road, distinct from probationary reduction and motorway rain.
scenario: Driver POV rural French TWO-lane undivided road, one lane each direction, wet road with visible rain streaks on windscreen and working wiper at lower edge, good visibility much greater than 50m. Red-rimmed circular white sign with black '90' on right. Daylight no other hazards.

fr.question_text: Il pleut sur cette route à double sens sans séparateur central, normalement limitée à 90 km/h. Quelle limite maximale dois-je respecter ?
fr.answer_a: 90 km/h car le panneau ne change pas.
fr.answer_c: 50 km/h dès la première goutte, quelle que soit la visibilité.
fr.explanation: Sous la pluie, la vitesse maximale sur cette route ordinaire est de 80 km/h. Je roule encore moins vite si l’adhérence, la visibilité ou la circulation l’exigent.

en.question_text: It is raining on this undivided two-way road normally limited to 90 km/h. What maximum applies?
en.answer_a: 90 km/h because the sign has not changed.
en.answer_c: 50 km/h from the first drop, regardless of visibility.
en.explanation: In rain, the maximum on this ordinary road is 80 km/h. I drive more slowly if grip, visibility or traffic require it.

visual_review: Reviewed: visible rain and wiper, wet undivided ordinary road with 90 sign and visibility well over 50 m. D alone selects rain maximum 80, explanation retains lower safe speed when needed. FR/EN and four choices checked.
